name: Alchemist's Supplies
description: Vials, beakers, and reagents used to identify potions, brew acid or alchemist's fire, and craft mundane potions.

name: Brewer's Supplies
description: The tools and ingredients of brewing — used for crafting beverages, identifying ales, and similar tasks.

name: Calligrapher's Supplies
description: Quills, ink, and parchment for fine letterwork — forging documents, decoding scripts, identifying scribal work.

name: Carpenter's Tools
description: Saws, chisels, hammers, and nails for building wooden structures and crafting wooden items.

name: Cook's Utensils
description: Pots, pans, and a fire kit for preparing meals — a key part of long-rest morale on the road.

name: Leatherworker's Tools
description: Edged tools, mallets, and an awl for crafting leather goods — armor, scabbards, packs.

name: Smith's Tools
description: Hammer, tongs, and an anvil for shaping metal — repairing weapons and armor, identifying their construction.

name: Tinker's Tools
description: A jumble of small mechanical parts and engineering tools used to repair locks and construct ad-hoc devices.

name: Weaver's Tools
description: A small loom, needles, and thread for crafting cloth, repairing garments, and identifying textiles.

name: Thieves' Tools
description: Lockpicks, an etched mirror, narrow-bladed scissors. Used to pick locks, disarm traps, and similar acts of larceny.

name: Herbalism Kit
description: Pouches and instruments for working with plants — identify, brew potions of healing, craft antitoxin.

name: Navigator's Tools
description: A sextant, compass, calipers, and similar instruments for plotting a course at sea or in the air.

name: Poisoner's Kit
description: Vials, chemicals, and equipment for crafting poisons. Many regions outlaw possession outright.

name: Dice Set
description: A small set of bone or wooden dice. Proficiency is most often used in social games of chance.

name: Playing Card Set
description: A deck of playing cards. Useful for gambling, sleight of hand displays, and divinatory parlor tricks.

name: Drum
description: Hand-held percussion. Bards may use it as a spell focus.

name: Flute
description: Wooden wind instrument. A common bardic focus.

name: Lute
description: Stringed instrument iconic to traveling bards. May serve as a spell focus.

name: Lyre
description: Small harp-like instrument with a smaller, sweeter tone than a full harp.

name: Horn
description: A small brass horn for carrying tunes or marshaling allies on a battlefield.
